public_comment.topic: Concerned about parking overflow from the proposed two-family conversion at 990 Mass Ave and asked for a fence between her yard (which has a pool) and the property to protect any children who might move in.

minutes.headline: ZBA approved special permits for the Chase Road Subaru dealership rebuild and a Mass Ave two-family conversion
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two special permit applications: a rebuild of the Subaru dealership at 757 Chase Road (continuing non-conforming setbacks for vehicle display/parking, with a new landscape buffer from the road), and conversion of a single-family home at 990 Mass Ave into a two-family dwelling. Both were approved by voice vote with conditions, including a requested fence at the Mass Ave property to address a neighbor's safety concerns about parking and children.

votes.motion: Approve the special permit for 757 Chase Road (Subaru dealership rebuild) with the conditions outlined in the previous special permit
Grant the special permit for 990 Mass Ave (single-family to two-family conversion) with the condition that the applicant consider a fence to appease the neighbors

votes.outcome: passed (voice vote, all in favor heard)

budget_items.topic: Colonial Auto Group's recent Belmont facility construction, cited by the applicant as context for dealership rebuild costs
budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant's representative said the company spent this amount in the last 6 months building a similar new-standard dealership in Belmont, offered as context for the scale of Subaru's branding requirements.

decisions.decision: Applicant agreed to pull the landscape island back 5 feet from the property line as a barrier so display vehicles do not creep closer to Chase Road over time.
Applicant agreed, without formal opposition, to consider installing a fence between the McDonald property and the subject lot to address child-safety concerns.
Board agreed it will need to select a new vice chair at an upcoming meeting, with the outgoing vice chair offering to pass along his hearing-conduct notes to whoever takes over.

what_happened.line: ZBA approved a special permit for the Chase Road Subaru dealership rebuild, continuing non-conforming display/parking setbacks with a new landscape buffer.
ZBA approved a special permit converting a single-family home at 990 Mass Ave into a two-family dwelling, conditioned on considering a fence.
A neighbor with a pool raised parking overflow and child-safety concerns about the Mass Ave conversion before the vote.
The board noted it will need to pick a new vice chair at an upcoming meeting.

why_it_matters: The Chase Road permit lets the dealership keep existing setback exceptions for vehicle display and parking rather than bring the site into full conformance, with a landscape buffer as the tradeoff.
The Mass Ave permit adds a second housing unit to a residential lot, and the fence was requested, not required, so whether it goes in depends on the applicant following through.
Both are zoning special permits, not tax or budget votes, but they set conditions a resident living nearby will need to check are actually met.
